SCOPE: Localize only the mounted DraftEditor approval child and its focused tests using the existing six-locale catalog and LocaleProvider. Add typed catalog keys and translations for every user-visible DraftEditor label, helper, validation, retry, confirmation and terminal state. Preserve authored caption/hashtag/platform data as data.
ALLOWED_PATHS: packages/core/src/locale.ts; packages/core/src/locale-catalogs.ts; packages/dashboard/components/DraftEditor.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/DraftEditor.test.tsx
PRESERVE: expectedRevisionId payload; trimmed per-destination captions; hashtag bounds; keep/change/remove schedule semantics; exact existing requested instant; approvalSlot conversion; idempotency key and unchanged-intent retry; response identity/state/ToS-pending checks; no-publication wording; terminal reload behavior.
ACCEPTANCE: Every visible DraftEditor string is catalog-backed; at least one non-English mounted-render assertion proves translated controls and no English fallback; existing behavior tests remain green; core build and tests pass; focused DraftEditor tests pass; dashboard typecheck and lint pass; diff check passes. Report exact commands and exit codes actually run. If any required gate cannot run, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact command and reason rather than claiming delivery.
DELIVERY_REQUIREMENTS: DELIVERY must name the artifact path, SHA256, changed files, exact commands, exit codes, test result and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. A helper-only change, catalog-only change, untested claim, moving-ref checkout or runtime/provider claim is not accepted.
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge implementation, deployment, live database, migrations, runtime services, containers, systemd, providers, credentials, permissions, publication, billing, payouts, network or external messaging.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
sincerely, Codex
